<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_snc_createnotes.HVSUserContractUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>HVSUserContractUtils</name><sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var HVSUserContractUtils = Class.create();
HVSUserContractUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

	isUserPartOfDepartment : function(userId, departments){
		var userContractDetails = this.getDetailsFromAllUserContracts(userId);
		var userDepartments = userContractDetails.departments;

		//Rajoute le département présent sur sys_user au cas ou l'utilisateur n'as pas de contrats
		var user = gs.getUser().getUserByID(userId);
		var userDepartment = user.getDepartmentID();

		if(userDepartments.indexOf(userDepartment) === -1)
			userDepartments.push(userDepartment);

		return userDepartments.some(function(userDep){
			return departments.indexOf(userDep) > -1;
		});

	},

	isUserPartOfCompany : function(userId, companies){
		var userContractDetails = this.getDetailsFromAllUserContracts(userId);
		var userCompanies = userContractDetails.companies;

		//Rajoute la compagnie présent sur sys_user au cas ou l'utilisateur n'as pas de contrats
		var user = gs.getUser().getUserByID(userId);
		var userCompany = user.getCompanyID();

		if(userCompanies.indexOf(userCompany) === -1)
			userCompanies.push(userCompany);

		return userCompanies.some(function(userComp){
			return companies.indexOf(userComp) > -1;
		});
	},
	
	getDetailsFromAllUserContracts : function(userId){
		var depts = [];
		var companies = [];

		
		if(userId){
			var uc = new GlideRecord('u_hvs_user_contract');
			uc.addQuery('u_user', userId);
			uc.addQuery('u_active', true);
			uc.query();
			while(uc.next()){
				var dept = uc.getValue('u_departement_ref');
				var company = uc.getValue('u_company');
				if(depts.indexOf(dept) === -1)
					depts.push(dept);
				if(companies.indexOf(company) === -1)
					companies.push(company);
			}
		}

		var contractDetails = {};
		contractDetails.companies = companies;
		contractDetails.departments = depts;

		return contractDetails;

	},

    getContractInfos: function() {
        var contract_object = {};
        var gr = new GlideRecord('u_hvs_user_contract');

        gr.get(this.getParameter('sysparm_contract_id'));

        if (gr) {
            contract_object['active'] = gr.getValue('u_active');
            contract_object['manager_id'] = gr.getValue('u_user_managers');
            contract_object['manager'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_user_managers');
            contract_object['dept_id'] = gr.getValue('u_departement_ref');
            contract_object['dept'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_departement_ref');
            contract_object['job_location'] = gr.getValue('u_user_job_location');
            contract_object['company_id'] = gr.getValue('u_company');
            contract_object['company'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_company');
            contract_object['activity_rate'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_activity_rate');
            contract_object['funct'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_user_label_code');
            contract_object['contract_type_id'] = gr.getValue('u_contract_type');
            contract_object['contract_type'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_contract_type');
            contract_object['contrat_number'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_contrat_number');
            contract_object['commitment_date'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_user_commitment_date');
            contract_object['end_date'] = gr.getDisplayValue('u_user_end_date');

        }

        return JSON.stringify(contract_object);
    },

    getPreferredContract: function() {
        var u = gs.getUser().getUserByID(this.getParameter('sysparm_user_id'));

        // PSO - 16.09.2021
        // Return first active contract if preferred contract is not active
        var sContractID = this._CheckPreferredContract(u.getPreference('hvs.user_contract.prefered'), this.getParameter('sysparm_user_id'));
        return sContractID;
        //return u.getPreference('hvs.user_contract.prefered');
    },

    _CheckPreferredContract: function(contract_id, user_id) {
        var retValue;
        var grUHUC = new GlideRecord('u_hvs_user_contract');
        grUHUC.addEncodedQuery('u_user=' + user_id + 'sys_id=' + contract_id + '^u_active=true');
        grUHUC.query();
        if (grUHUC.hasNext()) {
            retValue = '' + contract_id;
        } else {
            var grUHUC_GetFirstActive = new GlideRecord('u_hvs_user_contract');
            grUHUC_GetFirstActive.addEncodedQuery('u_user=' + user_id + '^u_active=true');
            grUHUC_GetFirstActive.setLimit(1);
            grUHUC_GetFirstActive.orderBy('sys_created_on');
            grUHUC_GetFirstActive.query();
            if (grUHUC_GetFirstActive.hasNext()) {
				grUHUC_GetFirstActive.next();
                retValue = '' + grUHUC_GetFirstActive.sys_id;
                var u = gs.getUser().getUserByID(user_id);
                u.savePreference('hvs.user_contract.prefered', retValue);
            }
        }

        return retValue;
    },

    setPreferredContract: function() {
        var u = gs.getUser().getUserByID(this.getParameter('sysparm_user_id'));
        var contract_id = this.getParameter('sysparm_contract_id');
        u.savePreference('hvs.user_contract.prefered', contract_id);
        return;
    },

    type: 'HVSUserContractUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>h40009222</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-23 18:36:25</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_id>a1f4ed5587df5a104102cd0a0cbb35ca</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HVSUserContractUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CreateNotes" source="x_snc_createnotes">df5fd9a5090232007f44e1046c8ff69f</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="CreateNotes">df5fd9a5090232007f44e1046c8ff69f</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a1f4ed5587df5a104102cd0a0cbb35ca</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>h40009222</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-23 18:36:25</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
